description: This file contains a class 'RetellAIServiceMapper' with static methods for mapping and formatting data related to RetellAI service integration, including configuration mapping, agent formatting, and update data extraction.

classes.name: RetellAIServiceMapper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for mapping between service/interface types and internal Retell types for RetellAI integration.

methods.name: buildGeneralTools
methods.description: Maps AI configuration to Retell tools format, including calendar tools if configured.

methods.name: mapToCreateLLMRequest
methods.description: Maps AI configuration to CreateLLMRequest object.

methods.name: mapToCreateAgentRequest
methods.description: Creates a request object for creating a new agent with specified LLM ID, event type, and voice ID.

methods.name: mapToUpdateLLMRequest
methods.description: Maps update model parameters to an UpdateLLMRequest object.

methods.name: mapToUpdateAgentRequest
methods.description: Maps agent update data to an UpdateAgentRequest object.

methods.name: mapPhoneNumberUpdateData
methods.description: Prepares phone number update data for inbound and outbound agents.

methods.name: formatAgentForList
methods.description: Formats agent data for listing response.

methods.name: formatAgentDetails
methods.description: Formats detailed agent data including Retell agent and LLM details.

methods.name: extractLLMUpdateData
methods.description: Extracts LLM update data from parameters.
